archer.name: Archer
archer.description: Deadly marksman who picks off distant foes with high-impact arrows.
archer.codex: A keen-eyed sharpshooter who holds the backline and never breaks formation. Looses high-damage arrows across open line of sight to drive advancing foes back.

skills.name: Snipe Arrow
skills.description: High-damage arrow that inflicts heavy knockback.

armored_axeman.name: Armored Axeman
armored_axeman.description: Heavy vanguard who carves through enemy packs with sweeping axe cleaves.
armored_axeman.codex: An ironclad vanguard who steps forward to meet oncoming hordes head-on. Cuts through tight enemy groups with heavy cleaves and punishing knockback bursts.

skills.name: Axe Chop
skills.description: Wide melee cleave with light knockback.

skills.name: Whirlwind Cleave
skills.description: Sweeping AoE cleave dealing heavy damage and strong knockback.

knight.name: Knight
knight.description: Armored guardian who draws enemy aggro and stuns threats at close range.
knight.codex: A steadfast bastion of steel who anchors the frontline and draws enemy aggro away from backline allies. Endures heavy punishment while stunning nearby foes.

skills.name: Sword Strike
skills.description: Disciplined melee slash that holds the line.

skills.name: Heavy Swing
skills.description: Shield-bashing blow that stuns nearby foes.

skills.name: Taunt
skills.description: Draws nearby enemy aggro and forces struck foes to focus the Knight.

knight_templar.name: Knight Templar
knight_templar.description: Stalwart polearm warrior who keeps swarms at bay with forceful pike thrusts.
knight_templar.codex: A sworn defender of the fellowship who guards the vanguard with a long-reach pike. Repels advancing waves with relentless knockback strikes.

skills.name: Pike Thrust
skills.description: Long-reach melee thrust with strong knockback.

skills.name: Heavy Smite
skills.description: Empowered polearm strike dealing high damage and heavy knockback.

priest.name: Priest
priest.description: Devoted cleric who mends wounded allies and smites foes with holy light.
priest.codex: A sacred caretaker sheltered at the heart of the formation. Prioritizes critically wounded allies in combat, mends the party between fights, and calls down stunning light when allies are safe.

skills.name: Divine Heal
skills.description: Restores health to the most wounded ally.

skills.name: Holy Smite
skills.description: Calls down holy light from afar, damaging and stunning a foe.

soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.description: Versatile skirmisher who marks distant foes for bonus party damage and fights up close.
soldier.codex: A seasoned tactician who fights close to the leader. Fires arrows at unmarked foes so the entire party deals bonus damage, drawing a swift blade whenever enemies close in.

skills.name: Arrow Shot
skills.description: Prioritizes unmarked foes, applying Mark for bonus party damage.

skills.name: Sword Slash
skills.description: Swift close-range sword strike against nearby foes.

swordsman.name: Swordsman
swordsman.description: Agile duelist who overwhelms targets with fast slashes and three-hit flurries.
swordsman.codex: A swift blademaster who darts from the frontline to cut down priority targets. Chains relentless sword strikes into devastating three-hit bursts.

skills.name: Quick Slash
skills.description: Fast single-target sword strike on a short cooldown.

skills.name: Blade Flurry
skills.description: Unleashes a rapid 3-hit combo for high burst damage.

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.description: Arcane caster whose piercing frost bolts chill and slow advancing packs.
wizard.codex: A scholar of frost magic who holds the backline and seeks out unchilled foes. Launches piercing ice bolts through up to two enemies to slow their advance.

skills.name: Frost Bolt
skills.description: Pierces up to 2 foes, inflicting Slow.

torchero.name: Torchero
torchero.description: Mysterious flame-bearer who lights dark halls and ignites foes with burn.
torchero.codex: An enigmatic wanderer carrying an undying ember into the abyss. Illuminates surrounding darkness and seeks out unburned foes to set packs ablaze.
torchero.unlock_hint: A hidden ally awaits. Some forgotten flames still sleep in the dark...

skills.name: Torch Strike
skills.description: Fiery melee strike that inflicts Burn damage over time.

skills.name: Torchlight
skills.description: Illuminates nearby darkness and prioritizes igniting unburned foes.
